title: Characterizing Contention-Induced Reliability Collapse in KV-Cache Timing Side Channels for Multi-Tenant LLM Serving
abstract: arXiv:2609.06853v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Shared key--value (KV) cache reuse improves large language model (LLM) serving, but it can also create a timing side channel that reveals whether a prefix is already cached. Previous work shows that such attacks are possible, but their reliability under realistic multi-tenant contention is less understood. We study this problem through seven experiments on live shared LLM-serving systems. On a vLLM server running DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B on NVIDIA GB10, mean Cohen's d drops from 0.7789 with no synthetic workers to 0.2109 with two workers (t=8.412), while higher worker counts cause no statistically detectable further loss. A 120-run sparse-overlap experiment places the best breakpoint at the boundary of the measured range (tau=0, 95% CI [0.000,0.113]), supporting an ambient-versus-loaded regime change rather than an internal physical threshold. AUROC falls from 0.650 at ambient to 0.531 near 61% overlap and partially recovers to 0.5

translated_title: 多租户大语言模型服务中KV缓存计时侧信道因资源竞争导致的可靠性崩溃特性研究
translated_abstract: 共享键值（KV）缓存复用可以提升大语言模型（LLM）的服务效率，但它也可能形成一种计时侧信道，泄露某个前缀是否已被缓存。先前的研究表明此类攻击是可行的，但其在真实多租户竞争环境下的可靠性尚不清楚。我们通过对在线运行的共享LLM服务系统开展七项实验来研究这一问题。在NVIDIA GB10硬件上运行DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B模型的vLLM服务器上，平均Cohen's d效应量从无合成工作负载时的0.7789降至有两个工作负载时的0.2109（t=8.412），而进一步增加工作负载数量并未带来统计上可检测的额外损失。一项120次运行的稀疏重叠实验将最佳断点定位于测量范围的边界处（tau=0，95%置信区间[0.000, 0.113]），这支持了“环境空闲状态与负载状态之间存在机制转变”的解释，而非存在内部物理阈值。AUROC从环境空闲状态的0.650下降至约61%重叠时的0.531，随后部分回升至0.5…（原文摘要至此被截断）
tldr: 该论文首次通过在真实共享LLM服务系统上的七项系统实验，量化表征了多租户资源竞争对KV缓存计时侧信道攻击可靠性的崩溃性影响，发现少量并发负载即可使攻击效应量大幅下降，且存在环境空闲与高负载之间的机制转变而非内部物理阈值。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically characterizes, through seven experiments on live shared LLM-serving systems, how multi-tenant contention induces a reliability collapse in KV-cache timing side-channel attacks, showing that even minimal concurrent workloads sharply reduce the effect size, with evidence of an ambient-versus-loaded regime change rather than an internal physical threshold.
